homepage.hero.tagline.message: A unified model for thinking about, designing and operating security in software development.

homepage.hero.subtitle.message: SbD–ToE connects European regulations, technical standards, maturity frameworks, real threats and software engineering in a prescriptive, reusable and risk-proportional manual.

homepage.diagram.caption.message: SbD–ToE is the core where standards, threats and engineering converge. From this centre, each chapter of the manual unfolds the vision into concrete practices and controls.

homepage.description.message: Security by Design - Theory of Everything. A practical, open and prescriptive manual for applying security by design in modern organisations.
